svg.title: Graph of a positive-definite quadratic form
svg.desc: The surface z equals 3 x sub 1 squared minus 2 x sub 1 times x sub 2 plus 3 x sub 2 squared is an elliptical bowl with minimum at the origin. The x sub 1 and x sub 2 axes cross at the black dot on the floor. The vertical axis measures z. Two units from the origin in the floor plane, the marked heights are 16 on the solid curve in direction v prime 1 and 8 on the dashed curve in direction minus v prime 2. The elliptical rim is at z equals 36.
